key_findings: Perinatal adversity increased mechanical sensitivity and lowered hippocampal BDNF and serum oxytocin in adolescent rats; maternal oxytocin normalized pain and several gene changes.
Serum CGRP did not correlate with von Frey sensitivity, and maternal oxytocin affected it in a sex-specific way.
